title: jam-sudo/ngspipeline pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input: Perturb-seq samples with their gene-expression (GEX) and guide (sgRNA) library FASTQs. Several rows may share a sample_id (one per sequencing run/lane); their GEX pairs are merged, and guide pairs may be given on any subset of those rows. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

gex_r1.errorMessage: gex_r1 (cell barcode + UMI read) must be a .fastq.gz / .fq.gz path without spaces

gex_r2.errorMessage: gex_r2 (cDNA read) must be a .fastq.gz / .fq.gz path without spaces

guide_r1.errorMessage: guide_r1 (cell barcode + UMI read of the sgRNA library) must be a .fastq.gz / .fq.gz path without spaces

guide_r2.errorMessage: guide_r2 (protospacer read of the sgRNA library) must be a .fastq.gz / .fq.gz path without spaces

expected_cells.errorMessage: expected_cells must be a positive integer
